profile.headline: Computer Engineer
profile.summary: I am passionate about developing defense technologies, with a focus on embedded systems, real-time sensing and controls, and digital system design. My background includes a degree in Computer Engineering with an emphasis on embedded systems/IoT and a minor in Machine Learning, giving me a strong foundation in hardware/software development and algorithmic problem-solving. I enjoy collaborating with cross-functional teams to tackle complex challenges, and am looking to apply my skills to signal processing, autonomous systems, and state estimation.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Serving as the Tranche 2 Implementation Lead for FPGA-accelerated processing applications supporting space-based remote sensing missions. Leading implementation planning for Tranche 2 and coordinating with Tranche 3 and senior integration lead to translate program objectives into quarterly development plans, Jira epics, and actionable tasks across a 10-15 person integration team.

Leading system-level integration and implementation planning for the Tranche 2 algorithm pipeline, including determining realistic processing goals, output rates, algorithm staging, and the division of processing between FPGA hardware and CPU/software. Integrating the FPGA processing pipeline with cFS for mission state management, algorithm sequencing, data handling, and status messaging.

Continuing hands-on development and validation of FPGA-accelerated applications using C++, C++ HLS, AMD Xilinx FPGA hardware, and the Vitis toolchain. Diagnosing hardware and board-level integration issues, optimizing FPGA resource utilization and timing, and validating end-to-end processing pipelines and algorithm outputs.

positions.title: Software Engineer Associate
positions.description:
Optimizing and validating FPGA-accelerated applications for space-based remote sensing payloads using C++, C++ HLS, AMD Xilinx FPGA hardware, and the Vitis toolchain. Developing comprehensive C++ unit tests for HLS-based algorithms and integrating algorithm kernels into end-to-end FPGA processing pipelines for space mission applications. 

Supporting Tranche 2 and Tranche 3 pipeline integration and hardware validation by deploying algorithm kernels and software drivers to FPGA hardware and executing end-to-end processing flows. Optimizing hardware implementations for FPGA resource utilization and timing while validating algorithm functionality and expected outputs. Contributing to software development workflows through GitLab-based project organization, documentation, testing, and collaborative development practices.

positions.title: Hardware / Ground Systems Engineer Associate
positions.description:
Improved the usability and reliability of Ground Systems documentation by reformatting 30+ procedures, fully rewriting several for clarity and technical accuracy, and reorganizing the procedure library for operational use. Authored procedure-writing guidelines and created an Excel-based tracking tool used by the GSE crew, becoming a go-to subject matter expert for procedures and documentation.

Supported live tests and events by monitoring ground system hardware and maintaining data connections. Later served as the most experienced Ground Systems Engineer in the on-shift crew, ensuring accurate and timely operational support while mentoring newer engineers in the test environment.

Contributed to Ground Systems Engineer training by developing additional targeted training material and delivering that content during live, in-person trainings, while assisting with hands-on portions of broader training efforts. Co-authored system monitoring and maintenance processes, documented Linux-based servers and workstations, and helped develop structured troubleshooting and data-path tracing workflows to support operational reliability.

positions.title: Drone Instructor & Technician
positions.locationName: Fort Collins, Colorado, United States · On-site
positions.description: Instructed hands-on flights with high-school students during the Drone Aviation Summer Program. Updated classroom curriculum to improve clarity and maximize student engagement. Ran in-class review sessions. Led hands-on flights with adult learners in Drone Flight Schools. Assisted the team on contracted projects, flying drones and supporting operations. Served as a technician on various projects, including designing adapters for drone attachments, modifying / assembling parts, and system integration / testing.
positions.insights: Skills: Soldering · Microelectronics · Power Systems · Technology Integration · System Testing · Microsoft PowerPoint · Drone Piloting · Aviation Regulations · Curriculum Innovation · Interpersonal Communication · Adult Education

positions.title: Radar Intern
positions.description: Conducted testing and data analysis to improve signal coherence between radar units. Designed and implemented a software capability enabling receive-only areas within a radar unit and modified backend code to selectively disable beam transmissions while maintaining reception. Verified software functionality through radar testing in an anechoic chamber, ensuring modified signal operations performed as intended.
positions.insights: Skills: Signal Processing · C++ · Radar · Design Verification Testing
